(23)  22­0981
  CD 10  RULES, ELECTIONS, AND INTERGOVERNMENTAL RELATIONS
  COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the appointment of Heather Hutt to hold
  the office of Council District 10; and related matters.

  Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Martinez ­
  Cedillo ­ Koretz ­ De Leon ­ O'Farrell) and Motion (Martinez ­ Krekorian ­
  O'Farrell):

  1. APPOINT Heather Hutt to hold the office of Councilmember of the
  Council District 10, unless Mr. Ridley­Thomas is acquitted or the
  charges against him are dismissed, whichever comes first.

  2. INSTRUCT the City Clerk, Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), and the
  City Attorney to report on options for Council to fill the permanent
  vacancy if the office of Council District 10 becomes permanently
  vacant, including the process for a special election.

  Fiscal Impact Statement: Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the
  CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.

  MOTION

  I HEREBY MOVE that the Rules, Elections, and Intergovernmental Relations Committee
Report relative to the appointment of Heather Hutt to hold the office of Council District 10; and
related matters, be AMENDED as follows:

  1. APPOINT Heather Hutt to hold the office of Councilmember of the Council District 10, *for
  so long as the temporary vacancy continues to exist, unless Mr. Ridley-Thomas is
  acquitted or the charges against him are dismissed, whichever comes first.
